final_resume.summary: B.Tech Information Technology graduate (2023) with 6 months of backend development experience building scalable REST services. Proficient in Data Structures and Algorithms with hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and MySQL. Seeking a Software Development Engineer role to apply strong problem-solving and collaborative skills in building distributed, production-grade systems.

projects.name: ShopEase - E-commerce Store
projects.description: Architected a Spring Boot and MySQL backend with React storefront, deployed on AWS EC2 with product images on S3. Implemented cart, checkout, and order history features, demonstrating full-stack integration and cloud deployment.

bullets: Built 6 REST endpoints in Spring Boot for the order-returns module backed by MySQL, enabling seamless order processing.
Wrote JUnit tests for the returns service, raising module coverage from 45% to 70% and improving code reliability.
Resolved 12 production bugs reported by the support team, demonstrating strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with distributed systems concepts (e.g., microservices, message queues, eventual consistency) through projects or coursework.
Deepen Object-Oriented Design knowledge by studying design patterns (Singleton, Factory, Observer) and applying them in real projects.
Build a project demonstrating system design at scale (e.g., a multi-service backend with load balancing or caching layers) to strengthen candidacy for senior roles.
final_resume.growth_note: Strong foundation in core algorithms and backend development, but limited exposure to distributed systems and advanced OOP design patterns. Recommend gaining these skills through targeted projects or open-source contributions before applying to senior SDE roles.
